#@path: src/core/ball_movement/ball_math.gd
class_name BallMath
extends RefCounted

## wrapf( is only named in a comment; so is TABLE[0] = 1.
const PI_HALF: float = PI / 2.0
const SNAP_EPSILON: float = 1e-6


static func f(x: float) -> float:
	var local: Array[float] = [1.0]
	local[0] = x
	return local[0]
